meta.description: Local drop-table and price snapshot for the OSRS Pet Hunt Profit Calculator. The app reads only this file; prices are refreshed by running update_prices.py, not by the app.
meta.dropSource: Old School RuneScape Wiki drop tables
meta.priceSource: wiki-page-snapshot (GE guide price shown on each Wiki drop table)
meta.calculation: Value per unit = sum(price x average quantity x expectedPerKill). expectedPerKill already includes multiple rolls and merged secondary tables (rare drop table, gem, seed, herb, shark and similar), using the Wiki's effective rates. Profit at pet rate = value per unit x petRate. 'unit' is usually a kill; skilling bosses and minigames use a reward roll or a completion.
notes: Only fixed pet rates are used; boss-specific assumptions are in each boss's 'notes'.
Untradeable items are 0 gp unless they have a 'valueNote' (a component valued as a share of the tradeable item it makes).
Drops with includeByDefault=false only drop under a condition (e.g. Brimstone keys on a Konar task).
Item prices are per single item. 'wikiAverage' is the Wiki's own stated average value per unit, for reference.
Bosses with perfectKillOption have qtyMinPerfect/qtyMaxPerfect on standard drops: the quantities on a perfect kill.
Doom of Mokhaiotl uses 'delveTables' (delves 1-8 and 9+) instead of 'drops'; 'qtyAvg' is the exact average quantity after the delve multiplier.
Theatre of Blood uses 'raidOption' (mode, team size) instead of 'drops'; see its howItWorks.
Chambers of Xeric uses a points-based 'raidOption' (type 'cox'); see its howItWorks.
Tombs of Amascut uses a points-based 'raidOption' (type 'toa'); see its howItWorks.
Royal Titans stores two loot tables under 'lootChoice' (the app uses the more valuable) and a 'duoOption'.
Nex and The Hueycoatl use 'teamOption' with per-drop 'teamScaling' (rate, quantity, mvpOnly, none).

Items with 'derivedFrom' are priced from other items: price = sum(item price x factor) over its terms (e.g. Tokkul = Uncut onyx / 260,000; vestiges = ring - 3 chromium ingots). Items marked referenceOnly are only used for these formulas.

bosses.name: Chambers of Xeric
bosses.notes: Deathless raids with points shared equally, so you hold 1/team size of the team's points. Every 8,676 team points gives a 1% unique chance, capped at 65.7% per roll (570,000 points), with extra points rolling further uniques (up to 6). Olmlet is a 1/53 roll each time you receive a unique. Without a unique you get two different common drops, sized by your personal points (capped at 131,071); a third of herb drops come as seeds instead. The default points are a rough estimate: enter your usual team total for accurate results.

raidOption.howItWorks: Team points T (plus 5,000 per player for a Challenge Mode target time). Unique roll k has chance clamp(T - 570,000*(k-1), 0, 570,000) / 867,600, for k = 1..6; you receive each with chance 1/teamSize. Common drops need no unique for you: 2 distinct items from 33 equally weighted, quantity = maxQty * min(T/teamSize, 131,071) / 131,071. Pet: 1/53 per unique you receive. Raid scale only sets the default points estimate.

bosses.name: Doom of Mokhaiotl
bosses.notes: Counted per run: you clear every delve from 1 down to your chosen delve, then claim all the loot. Each delve rolls the regular table once, with quantities scaled by that delve's multiplier, plus its own unique and pet chances. Dom can only drop from delve 6 onwards, so the pet rate per run depends on how deep you go.

delveOption.howItWorks: A run to delve D includes the tables for delves 1..min(D,8), plus the '9+' table once for each delve from 9 to D.

bosses.name: Duke Sucellus
bosses.notes: Post-quest (not awakened) kills. Standard loot quantities are about 50% higher on a perfect kill (no avoidable damage taken); set your expected perfect-kill percentage in the calculator.

bosses.name: The Gauntlet
bosses.notes: Counted per completed normal Gauntlet (Crystalline Hunllef): crystal shards plus two rolls on the main table. Youngllef is 1/2,000 here, compared with 1/800 in the Corrupted Gauntlet.

bosses.name: The Hueycoatl
bosses.notes: Equal damage, and you're MVP as often as your teammates (MVP gets a 10% bigger share). The Wiki's quantities and the 1/18 unique chance are for a solo kill; in a team they scale with your share of the damage, relative to a solo player. The pet's 1/400 base rate is also scaled by your contribution. Assumes you meet the damage thresholds for full loot.

teamOption.howItWorks: share = (1/N)(1 + mvpBonus/N) / (1 + mvpBonus), so a solo player gets the listed amounts. Pet chance x share.

bosses.name: Nex
bosses.notes: Equal damage, and you're MVP as often as your teammates (MVP gets +10% common loot and unique chance), so your average share is 1/team size x (1 + 0.1/team size). Uniques are 1/43 x your share (Jagex). Common loot is the whole kill's loot pile split by share; the pile is derived from the Wiki's duo and 5-player money making guides, which agree to within about 1%. Supplies (sharks, potions) and ecumenical key shards are left out, as in those guides. Nexling is a separate 1/500 roll for each player.

teamOption.howItWorks: share = (1/N)(1 + mvpBonus/N). 'rate' drops: chance x share; 'quantity' drops: quantity x share; 'mvpOnly': chance 1/N; 'none': unchanged. Pet is not scaled.

bosses.name: The Nightmare
bosses.notes: Equal damage, and you're MVP as often as your teammates. Each unique goes to one player, so your chance is the team's chance divided by team size; parties over 5 get a bonus second roll with (team size - 5)% chance, capped at 75%. The Nightmare's health scales with team size, so each player's common loot is taken as the Wiki's listed range (as in its 5-player money making guide), plus the MVP's 10% bonus shared evenly. Little Nightmare is 1/800 x team size, capped at 1/4,000 from 5 players; the MVP's 5% bonus to tertiary drops applies to the pet only at 5+ players.

teamOption.howItWorks: uniqueShared: chance x (1 + clamp((min(N,80)-5)/100, 0, 0.75)) / N. quantityMvp: quantity x (1 + 0.1/N). tertiaryMvp: chance x (1 + 0.05/N). mvpOnly: chance 1/N. Pet: 1/(800 x min(N,5)), with x(1 + 0.05/N) at 5+ players.

bosses.name: Royal Titans
bosses.notes: You choose which titan to loot after each kill; the calculator uses whichever table is worth more at current prices. Uses the 'Loot' option (two main rolls). In a duo, contribution is split equally: regular quantities and unique chances are halved, while the pet (1/3,000) and clue chances are unchanged. Sacrificing the loot for double pet chance isn't modelled. The one-off prayer scrolls (Mystic vigour and Deadeye) are assumed already unlocked, so they never drop.

duoOption.howItWorks: Drops with contributionScales 'quantity' have quantities x share; 'rate' drops have chance x share; tertiary drops are unchanged.

bosses.name: Sol Heredit
bosses.notes: Counted per full Colosseum run (waves 1-12 claimed together). The pet is a 1/200 roll on completing wave 12. Dizana's quiver can either be gambled with Minimus for a second 1/200 pet roll (about 1/100 per run in total) or exchanged for 4,000 sunfire splinters; choose which on the page.

quiverOption.howItWorks: gamble: pet chance per run = 1 - (1 - 1/petRate)(1 - extraPetChance), quiver worth 0. exchange: pet 1/petRate, plus 4,000 sunfire splinters per run.

bosses.name: Tempoross

bosses.name: Theatre of Blood
bosses.notes: Deathless raids, with the unique split evenly across the team (you get MVP as often as your teammates). The team's unique chance doesn't change with team size, so your share is the team chance divided by team size. If you don't get the unique you get 3 rolls on the common table, with quantities split by contribution, so each player gets 1/team size of the listed amounts. Your pet and tertiary chances are rolled for you personally, so they don't depend on team size. Common loot quantities assume full personal contribution.

raidOption.howItWorks: Per player per raid: each unique = teamUniqueChance / teamSize x weight. Common items = (1 - teamUniqueChance / teamSize) x commonRolls x chancePerRoll, with quantity x commonMultiplier / teamSize (or targetTimeCommonMultiplier for Hard Mode within the target time). Tertiary chances and petRate are per player.

bosses.name: Tombs of Amascut
bosses.notes: Deathless raids with equal contribution, so each player holds 1/team size of the team's points. The team gets 1% unique chance per (10,500 - 20 x scaled raid level) points, capped at 55%, and your share is 1/team size. Without a unique you get 3 common rolls sized by your own points, with +15% loot at raid level 300 and +1% per 5 levels above. The pet is 1% per (350,000 - 700 x scaled raid level) of your points. Below raid level 150 (50 for fang and Lightbearer) a rolled unique only converts at 1/50. Points exclude the starting 5,000. The default points are a rough estimate: enter your own for accurate results. Thread of Elidinis, jewels and clues are untradeable and not counted.

raidOption.howItWorks: P = points per player (excluding the starting 5,000, capped at 59,000); team points T = P x team size. Unique scaled level u = L (L<=310), 310+(L-310)/3 (<=430), 350+(L-430)/6 (above). Team unique chance = min(0.55, T / (100 x (10,500 - 20u))); yours = that / team size. Common: (1 - your unique chance) x 3 rolls x 1/27 per item, qty = P / divisor x (1 if L<300 else 1.15 + 0.01 x floor((L-300)/5)). Pet: scaled level v = L (<=400), 400+(L-400)/3 (<=550), 450 above; chance = P / (100 x (350,000 - 700v)).
